title: Implement a scheduled purge job for expired user data and revoked credentials
description: Add onfinance_db_model_master/purge.py exposing purge_expired(now, report_only=True). It (a) erases or anonymises the User PII fields named in the task 1 schedule (user_email, user_phone_number, user_password, user_binance_auth_creds, user_chats, profile_answers, user_fcm_id) where retention_until < now; (b) deletes Secrets documents linked to a user whose consent_withdrawn_at is set or whose broker connection was removed, without waiting for TTL; (c) logs per-run counts, and never field values. Schedule it daily in the consuming service's scheduler, outside market hours. Run in qa first. Consent-withdrawal erasure must also be triggered on demand, within the schedule's timeline.
acceptanceCriteria: In qa, a seeded User with retention_until in the past has every scheduled PII field null or anonymised after purge_expired(now, report_only=False), and a seeded User with retention_until in the future is unchanged
In qa, withdrawing consent for a test user leaves db.secrets.countDocuments for that user at 0 after the job runs
Run logs contain counts of users anonymised and secrets deleted per run and contain no PII or credential values

verificationMethod.description: In qa, seed three users (retention expired, retention in the future, consent withdrawn) with linked secrets, and run purge_expired first with report_only=True, then False. Expected: the report-only run lists exactly the expired and withdrawn users and changes nothing; the real run anonymises only those two users and deletes only their secrets; logs show counts only.

rootCause.description: No erasure path exists anywhere in the codebase, so even with retention fields, data past its purpose or with consent withdrawn would never be removed.
